bias.label: Leaning up while above 4,088; faded from 4,135 before CPI

event: US October CPI, Tue 10 Nov 15:30 SAST. US PPI Fri 13 Nov 15:30 SAST.

bullets.title: Gave back gains
bullets.text: Spot gold was about 4,105 at 19:14 SAST, still up about 0.85% on the day but 30 below the 4,135 high (Kitco).

bullets.title: Day range
bullets.text: Today's spot range is 4,053-4,135, and the morning high was the best level since 21 October (Kitco, Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Dollar softer
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 101.8, down about 0.5% on the day, which still supports gold (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Oil falling
bullets.text: Trading Economics shows Brent down about 4.8% near 93.6, which eases inflation worries (another page shows 97.7, so the size of the drop is UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Hike odds high
bullets.text: Markets price about an 80% chance of a Fed hike in December, which caps how far gold can run (Trading Economics, Discovery Alert).

bullets.title: CPI tomorrow
bullets.text: October CPI lands Tue 15:30 SAST with about +0.3% m/m expected; hot data can push gold under 4,088, soft data can reopen 4,135-4,150 (Discovery Alert).

bullets.title: Yields unclear
bullets.text: Trading Economics shows a US yield near 4.88% but does not label the tenor, so treat it as UNVERIFIED.

levels.note: Key round number named as the floor (Discovery Alert)
